item.title: Glint 0.1.9
item.description:
Glint now updates itself.

  • Updates from inside Glint: once a day Glint checks for a new version and downloads it in the background. When it's ready, an Update button appears in the toolbar: one click restarts into it, with your windows and tabs back. Or just quit, and it installs.
  • Check any time: Glint ▸ Check for Updates…, or Settings ▸ About.
  • The last manual install: after this version, you won't need to download Glint again.

Signed and notarized by Apple: open the .dmg, drag Glint to Applications and replace the old copy.
